name: Mohammed V Mausoleum
hero_subtitle: White marble and zellige mausoleum of Mohammed V and Hassan II beside Hassan Tower.

overview.title: A modern memorial in a historic setting
overview.p1: The mausoleum honours Mohammed V and also houses the tomb of Hassan II. Guards in traditional dress, carved marble and coloured zellige make it one of Rabat’s most visited interiors. It stands on the same esplanade as Hassan Tower, so both sites work as a single stop.
overview.p2: Dress respectfully and follow staff instructions. Photography rules can vary inside — check on arrival.

q1.question: Is it free?
q1.answer: Entry is free; security screening applies.

q2.question: How long inside?
q2.answer: Twenty to forty minutes for most visitors.

q3.question: Can I take photos?
q3.answer: Often restricted inside — follow posted rules.

q4.question: Who is buried here?
q4.answer: Mohammed V and Hassan II, among others in the complex.

q5.question: Open every day?
q5.answer: Generally yes; hours can change on holidays.
